card.name: Leading digit of round tens doses
card.fires_on: A single digit such as 1, 4 or 6 that starts a two-digit dose ending in 0 (10, 40, 60) just before 'mg', written as separate digits in statin, prednisone and citalopram dosing text.

modes.label: Digit before final zero in statin doses
modes.description: The first digit of 10 mg or 40 mg doses of pravastatin or ezetimibe/simvastatin.
modes.example: is pravastatin sodium <<1>>0 mg once daily.

card.writes: It seems to steer the next token toward a zero digit and away from 'five' or 5, so a round ten-multiple dose is completed.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a round dose like 10, 40 or 60 mg, just before the trailing zero.
